units.source_text: 明石姬如此蹉跎光阴，又过了数日。

en.t: Lady Akashi passed the time in this way, and several more days went by.

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣很不安心，便顾不得人目注视，决心赴大堰访问。

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, grew very uneasy, and ignoring the eyes of others, resolved to visit Oi.

units.source_text: 他以前不曾将此事明确告知紫姬，但深恐她照例会从别人处听到，反而不好，

en.t: He had not clearly told Lady Murasaki about this before, but he feared that if she heard of it from someone else, as usual, it would only make matters worse,
so this time he told her the truth.

units.source_text: 又对她说：“桂院有些事，必须亲往料理，

en.t: He also said to her, "There are some matters at the Katsura villa that I must go and attend to in person,
and without realizing it, I have left them neglected for a long time.

units.source_text: 还有约定来京访我的人，正在那附近等待，不去也不好意思。

en.t: Besides, someone who promised to come to the capital to see me is waiting nearby, and it would be awkward not to go.

units.source_text: 再则嵯峨佛堂里的佛像，装饰尚未完成，也得去照料一下。

en.t: Moreover, the decorations on the Buddhist images in the Saga chapel are still unfinished, so I must look after that as well.

units.source_text: 总须在那里耽搁两三天呢。”

en.t: All told, I shall have to stay there for two or three days."

units.source_text: 紫姬以前曾听人说过他突然营造桂院，现在料想是要给明石姬住的了，

en.t: Lady Murasaki had once heard that he had suddenly built the Katsura villa, and now supposed it must be meant as a residence for Lady Akashi,

units.source_text: 心中很不高兴，答道：“你去那边两三天，

en.t: so she was deeply displeased and replied, "If you go there for two or three days,
perhaps even the handle of the axe will have rotted away by then.
You will make someone wait herself to death!"

units.source_text: 源氏内大臣说：“你又多心了！

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, said, "You are letting your suspicions run away with you again.

units.source_text: 大家都说我和从前完全不同了，只有你……”

en.t: Everyone says I am completely different from the way I used to be, but only you..."

units.source_text: 花言巧语地安慰了她一番之后，太阳已经很高了。

en.t: After soothing her for a while with graceful words, the sun was already high in the sky.
